title: Task-to-Session Dispatcher
observations: Architecture plan prevented double-rework through critical-gap interceptation (handoff re-dispatch timing)
Circular dependency solved with registry pattern; generalizable to other fabric-server integrations
Generation counter for stale-drain prevention is reusable pattern for event-handler disposal lifecycles
TDD red phase produced clear specification; green phase had singular focus with zero refactoring drift
Event-driven queue architecture is lean (no polling, no new tables) and naturally extends to priority/backoff
